title: B01 fixed-head frontier repair under commensurate QAVG and QEND semantics
scientific_question: After superseding the mixed fixed-head flux metric, which B01 low-dimensional Layer-ROM members still cross the bounded R2 development comparator when storage, cumulative exchange, QAVG and QEND are evaluated commensurately?

scope.comparator: R2 raw Richards trajectory from the same immutable C4R artifact

QAVG.Reference_and_R2: BOTTOM_OUTWARD_EXCHANGE / 0.001 d, required to match persisted BOTTOM_FLUX

QEND.Reference_and_R2: zero-head Darcy half-cell/layer diagnostic reconstructed from committed terminal bottom state
QEND.LayerROM: same zero-head Darcy half-layer diagnostic from candidate terminal state

superseded: old bottom_flux_sign_errors when candidate instantaneous q was compared to balance-materialized interval-average Reference BOTTOM_FLUX

comparator_rule.primary: Compare each Layer-ROM member with R2 componentwise on the corrected GW vector.
comparator_rule.crossing: Candidate crosses R2 only if no corrected GW component is worse than R2 beyond 1e-12 and at least one is strictly better.

FMC_handling.reason: The immutable C4R/D13 artifacts do not persist raw FMC terminal trajectories sufficient to recompute a QEND error against the corrected Reference diagnostic. Existing FMC terminal-flux errors used the now-superseded Reference flux semantics.
FMC_handling.rule: Do not infer or reconstruct an FMC corrected flux component from aggregate errors.

hard_controls: Reference and R2 QAVG must equal persisted BOTTOM_FLUX to numerical identity.
dt=0.0001 Layer-ROM rerun must reproduce retained B1 storage/cumulative/profile components before corrected flux metrics are interpreted.
Water ledger must satisfy existing research tolerance.
No new history, layer boundary, timestep or closure is introduced.

successor_logic.if_crossing_exists: Persist the smallest corrected R2-crossing dimension as a bounded B01 development frontier only; do not call it application-accepted.
successor_logic.if_none: Close the old B1 frontier and retain only componentwise fidelity curves.
successor_logic.B2_repair: One-day/reversal B2 authority remains separately held until its QAVG/QEND semantics are rebuilt.
